features.description: Read-side scoped-inference cost classifier in internal/observatory: per-stage cost_status in {reported,estimated,quota,unknown} using existing CalculateCostFromTokens; rollup reports reported/estimated/unknown totals + stage/token counts separately via chains stats. Estimation is a Go pass over per-stage rows (NOT the SQL SUM), resolving model from eval_assessment/spans; unresolvable model -> unknown (never faked $0). Quota lanes (tokens==0) NEVER estimated.
acceptance_criteria: chains stats shows non-zero cost_estimated-flagged cost for a token-bearing stage with no reported cost that resolves to a non-zero metered rate
a stage WITH self-reported cost is unchanged (no double-count)
a stage with tokens but no resolvable model is cost_status=unknown (a $0-rate model rolls up to $0), never a fabricated metered $0.0000
a quota/free-marked stage (tokens==0) is NEVER estimated
rollup reports reported/estimated/unknown cost + stage/token counts separately; budget comparison emits a visible incomplete-data warning or fails in strict mode
regression tests assert estimate / unchanged-reported / unknown / not-estimate-quota

posting never blocks or fails the iteration (fail-soft)
